verdict.rationale: Persona's docs confirm selfie verification with liveness checks exist ("Is the individual present during the transaction?") and identity verification includes liveness checks, but there is no documented detail on specific anti-spoofing defenses against printed photos, screen replays, or video injection attacks. Missing for 10: technical documentation of specific liveness detection methods, anti-spoofing test results, or independent/hands-on verification of defense against presentation attacks.
